Title: Crypto Wallet Enumeration
Description: Detects non-wallet processes accessing cryptocurrency wallet directories, a primary target of infostealer malware such as RedLine, Raccoon, and LummaC2.
Author: EdrBrain
FalsePositives: Rare in enterprise environments; wallet backup tools

Title: Scheduled Task Creation via Command Line
Description: Detects creation of scheduled tasks via schtasks.exe, a common persistence mechanism. While legitimate administrators create scheduled tasks, this rule identifies the execution pattern for correlation.
Author: EdrBrain

Title: DLL Loaded from Non-Standard Path
Description: Detects DLLs loaded from user-writable directories instead of System32, which may indicate DLL side-loading or search order hijacking attacks used by loaders and persisters.
Author: EdrBrain

Title: File Deletion by Unusual Process
Description: Detects file deletion events that may indicate anti-forensic activity, log wiping, or ransomware cleanup operations. Unusual processes deleting files in system directories are high-confidence indicators.
Author: EdrBrain
FalsePositives: Temp file cleanup by system processes
